title: Omitted title/author field returns 422, not 400
evidence: src/main.rs:26-32 BookInput makes title/author non-Option, so a body with the field entirely absent fails serde deserialization (axum -> 422); validate() at src/main.rs:64-68 only yields 400 for present-but-empty strings. Spec R9 expects 400.
suggestion: Make title/author Option<String> and reject None in validate() to return 400 uniformly.
